stories.title: Patient-reported trajectories reveal heterogeneity in ulcerative colitis
stories.takeaway: A Nature Medicine study proposes an ulcerative-colitis taxonomy based on individual patient-reported response trajectories rather than a single pooled response endpoint.
stories.what_happened: Schreiber and colleagues analyzed longitudinal patient-reported treatment-response trajectories to classify patterns of ulcerative colitis response.
stories.why_it_matters: Highlights how longitudinal patient-level outcomes can reveal clinically relevant variation that average treatment responses may obscure.
stories.caveat: Trajectory-derived categories require evaluation for reproducibility, clinical decision value and generalizability; patient-reported measures are not interchangeable with endoscopic remission.

stories.title: Mammalian archaeome review maps an overlooked dimension of gut ecology
stories.takeaway: A new Nature Reviews Microbiology review synthesizes the diversity and potential physiological roles of mammalian-associated archaea, particularly methanogens.
stories.what_happened: Kumpitsch and colleagues review archaeal colonization, microbial syntrophy, diet and host associations across humans and ruminants.
stories.why_it_matters: Broadens microbiome analysis beyond bacterial abundance toward interkingdom metabolic interactions and host physiology.
stories.caveat: Many disease links remain associative; cross-species comparisons and methane-production phenotypes do not establish causal effects in human disease.

stories.title: Spaceflight microbiome review emphasizes longitudinal host–microbe measurements
stories.takeaway: A new Genome Watch article discusses how spaceflight changes microbiome dynamics and why integrated host and metabolite measurements matter.
stories.what_happened: Javaid and Mateeva survey spaceflight microbiome studies and highlight longitudinal multi-omics as a way to contextualize changes during missions.
stories.why_it_matters: Illustrates how environmental perturbations motivate integrated measurements of microbial communities and host physiology.
stories.caveat: This is a short synthesis rather than a new controlled experiment; small astronaut cohorts and concurrent exposures limit causal interpretation.

stories.title: Endotrophin review connects extracellular matrix remodeling with fibroinflammation
stories.takeaway: Endotrophin, a collagen VI cleavage product, is discussed as a potential mediator and biomarker across fibrotic and metabolic diseases.
stories.what_happened: Maya-Ramos and colleagues synthesize preclinical and human evidence linking endotrophin with tissue remodeling, inflammation and metabolic dysfunction.
stories.why_it_matters: Offers a cross-organ framework for evaluating matrix-derived signals and fibrosis-related biomarkers in human tissue models.
stories.caveat: Biomarker association and experimental mechanistic evidence differ by disease; therapeutic targeting has not been broadly established in patients.

stories.title: Modular yeast biosynthesis advances routes to anticancer-drug precursors
stories.takeaway: A research highlight describes engineered yeast production of a direct precursor to etoposide and teniposide from glucose.
stories.what_happened: A Cell Discovery commentary discusses a Science study using a modular yeast biosynthesis platform for a plant-derived anticancer-drug precursor.
stories.why_it_matters: Shows how synthetic biology can diversify manufacturing routes for medically important small molecules.
stories.caveat: This is a commentary on another study, not independent validation; precursor synthesis does not itself demonstrate commercial-scale drug manufacture.
